name: index-options-grid-qqq-1-har-vix
notes: ADR-0187 cell qqq-1: QQQ condors 1-1 calendar days to settlement, label horizon 1 sessions, chain read within 0.05 log-moneyness, 15 yearly validation folds from 2011-01-01, embargo 8 days. The har-vix rung: generated from run-real-har-vix.json (index-options-real-har-vix) by index_options.grid.grid_document, so edit the base rung or the grid table and rewrite with write_grid, never this file. Needs a pulled ./ob holding optionshist-chain (index_daily + option_chain) and cboe-index (VIX). Run: python -m dskit.pipeline walkforward configs/grid/qqq-1.json --asof <today>. Never decision-eligible.

underlying.notes: QQQ raw daily closes with each ex-date's dividend_amount (the optionshist index_daily stream, ADR-0187). since_ms is 2000-03-21 UTC midnight: the first row after the last split, because raw prices are the strike basis and the reader refuses a flagged split.

vix.notes: VIX closes, keyed by date in vix_by_date for the join.

vix_by_date.notes: dskit keyby: {date: VIX close}, the side table the join reads (one close per date; a repeated date refuses).

market.notes: Same-date VIX close as iv_index for every underlying: VXN and RVX start only in 2009-09, and the S&P 500's implied vol is the proxy scale feature (ADR-0187); the implied book prices from each underlying's own chain iv instead. A date VIX lacks keeps iv_index null.

rv.notes: HAR-style daily/weekly/monthly realized vol, backward-only. rv_22 is the reference scale; all three are inputs for a later HAR rung.

labels.notes: ln(S_t+h / S_t) over h = 1 sessions, the bucket's label horizon (the sessions its lower DTE bound spans, ADR-0187); the embargo covers its calendar reach. Rows whose horizon runs past the data keep a null label.

fwd.notes: Realized per-step vol over the same 1 sessions as the label: the target a scale rung regresses on. Every rung of a cell shares this pipeline.

model.notes: log-HAR plus log VIX (HAR-IV, Busch/Christensen/Nielsen 2011): tests whether realized-vol history adds to the implied scale.

score.notes: Locked A0002 scores: twCRPS on the strike zones |z| in [0.5, 2.5], Brier at the candidate strikes, PIT KS and Berkowitz. Val labels overlap (21-step horizon on daily rows), so the p-values are diagnostics, not tests.

condor.notes: Shorts at one reference SD, wings at two, a fixed 30%-of-width credit (no quotes in synthetic data). Forecast vs realized P&L is a sanity check, never a selection criterion (A0003).

chain.notes: QQQ's archived 16:00 ET quotes for this bucket only, bounded at intake (root, 0.5 strike grid, settlement-date DTE, positive underlying close, log-moneyness band); one parsed snapshot per process serves every fold. The three bounds are restated on the backtest and pinned equal by test.

backtest.notes: ADR-0187 archived-quote condor backtest over val: one condor per entry date at the nearest listed expiry in the bucket, the next entry on or after its settlement date. Shorts at the forecast's short_q quantiles rescaled by sqrt(sessions / label_horizon), wings wing_z further out, every leg snapped outward onto a QUOTABLE listed strike (a short needs a bid and a bid size, a long an ask and an ask size); the implied book uses the chain's ATM iv. Settles at the last close within four days of the settlement date; the American charge (dividends on an ITM short call, carry at carry_rate on an ITM short put) comes off each book. Fills are the end-of-day touch at zero latency, so absolute P&L is indicative and the model / always / implied comparison on identical quotes is the signal. Never decision-eligible.

walkforward.notes: Expanding train windows on session rows; 15 yearly validation windows from 2011-01-01 (the archive's chains begin there for QQQ). embargo_days = dte_max + 7 = 8 covers both the label's reach (1 sessions, at most ceil(1.4 h) + 4 calendar days) and the settlement's reach (1 days), so no train label or settlement reaches past the validation cut.
